coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 8 ground-truth variable specifications (25%): both query directions and retrieval accuracy measured as the proportion of correct answers.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed IMDb top-1000/GPT-4-verified dataset with Wikidata/Wikipedia sampling. Does not specify the required GPT-3.5-turbo and Llama models or chat-versus-completion interaction modes. Temperature varies by experimental arm rather than model type. Uses McNemar and Wilcoxon tests instead of t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests. A pinned grading script does not establish the required fixed suite of dataset-creation, testing, and visualization scripts.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state the expected higher child-to-parent retrieval performance and significantly lower parent-to-child performance confirming the reversal curse.
